document.title: Afghanistan: Taliban Set to Shift "Diplomatic" Personnel in New York, Riyadh, and Islamabad (Islama 05710)
document.publisher: National Security Archive (GWU), The Taliban Biography: The Structure and Leadership of the Taliban 1996-2002
document.note: [Confidential] The Taliban are moving their "diplomatic" personnel; Taliban have official ties only with Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and the UAE. Discusses Abdul Wahab, Abdul Hakim Mujahid and Syed-ur Rahman Haqqani, one of the few non-Pashtun Taliban, educated in a Pakistani madrassa. Excised.

persons.name: Abdul Hakim Mujahid
persons.role: Taliban "ambassador" to Pakistan; returning to head Taliban office in New York

mentions.quote: ABDUL HAKIM MUJAHID, WHO IS NOW "AMBASSADOR" TO PAKISTAN, WILL GO TO NEW YORK
INVOLVED IN AFGHAN RESISTANCE POLITICS WITH NABI MOHAMMADI FOR MUCH OF THE 1980'S, MUJAHID IS ABOUT 45 AND FROM THE SOUTHERN PAKTIA

persons.name: Abdul Wahab
persons.role: Taliban diplomat in New York, to become first secretary at Afghan embassy in Riyadh

mentions.quote: ABDUL WAHAB, WHO WAS IN NEW YORK, WILL GO TO RIYADH

persons.name: Syed-ur Rahman Haqqani

mentions.quote: SYED-UR RAHMAN HAQQANI, IN HIS FIRST TALIBAN "DIPLOMATIC" ASSIGNMENT, TAKES OVER IN ISLAMABAD

events.description: Taliban reported set to rotate diplomatic personnel among New York, Riyadh and Islamabad.
Abdul Wahab told Acting Political Counselor he was unhappy in New York.
Abdul Wahab due to move to Riyadh.
US Embassy Islamabad reports Taliban will shift diplomatic personnel among New York, Riyadh, Islamabad.
Abdul Wahab told the acting political counselor he was unhappy in New York.
Abdul Wahab set to go to Riyadh as First Secretary of the Taliban embassy.
Mujahid to return to head Taliban office in New York; date unclear.
Syed-ur Rahman Haqqani to take over Taliban Embassy in Islamabad as caretaker.

sources_cited: Various sources; Taliban source; Consulate Peshawar coordination
key_claims: Taliban were rotating diplomatic personnel among New York, Riyadh and Islamabad in mid-1998.
Mujahid was seen as an effective Taliban representative at the UN.
Mujahid and Wahab are not part of the dominant Kandahari stream of Taliban.
Syed-ur Rahman Haqqani is expected to be a caretaker in Islamabad until a Kandahari arrives.
